ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 18
   C. 11
   D. 10

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

3. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

6. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
